system.what: A demon in a grey suit who steals voices
system.plan: Seven stolen voices to sing a door open
system.weakness: His own name spoken aloud, and salt
system.hiddenPlace: The old radio tower in the Heights
system.signature: Static: attack two different characters (the most Hurt, then the next most Hurt, standing; ties: roll a die); the first one he hurts can't cast on their next action (no Power, spell or potion; for the guardian no Mend or Carry). It ends after that action, or at the end of the next round.
